blocks.text: Schools: address checks (Surrey Schools School Locator, Sept 29, 2026)

parts.t: The City says Rosemary Heights is served by Rosemary Heights and Morgan elementary schools. My address checks:
The district lists Morgan Elementary at 3366 156A St, Rosemary Heights Elementary at 15516 36 Ave and Grandview Heights Secondary at 16987 25 Ave.
(3040 145A St) is also nearby, but I didn't check its catchment. Southridge is an independent school, not a Surrey School District school. Catchments change, so check the exact address with the
Do I need to belong to the golf club to live in Morgan Creek?
No. Morgan Creek Golf Course describes itself as a public course, so living here isn't tied to golf. For membership or course access, ask the course directly.
Is Rosemary Heights part of Morgan Creek?
On MLS®, yes. Rosemary Heights listings fall under the "Morgan Creek" sub-area. The City treats Rosemary Heights as its own planning area.
Which secondary school serves Morgan Creek?

All three addresses I checked on Morgan Creek Way and Rosemary Heights Crescent returned Grandview Heights Secondary, with Morgan or Rosemary Heights Elementary. Check the exact address, because catchments change.
Is there much new construction in Morgan Creek?
Not much. The City describes Rosemary Heights as largely built out, so most homes for sale are resales. For newer homes nearby, look at
What's the benchmark price for a Morgan Creek home?

There's no Morgan Creek-only benchmark. The South Surrey & White Rock detached benchmark was $1,612,500 in September 2026. For past sales in the "Morgan Creek" MLS® sub-area, see the table above: a median detached sale of $2,025,000 over the 12 months to Oct 7, 2026.
